assignments.reason: The בְּכוֹרָה (birthright) IS the service of prayer in this Torah: 'נָטַל אֶת הַבְּכוֹרָה, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת עֲבוֹדַת הַתְּפִלָּה בְּחִינוֹת פִּי שְׁנַיִם.' Its essential nature is the prayer-service itself — the double-mouthed weapon of praise and petition. Package 1 already contains the closely related node בכור (firstborn).

The coming of Mashiach IS the culmination of the prayer-Mashiach domain. 'אָז יָבוֹא מָשִׁיחַ, דָּא מֹשֶׁה' — Mashiach's arrival is identified with Moshe, and Mashiach's entire essence in this Torah is prayer. The node משיח is already in Package 1; יבוא משיח is the event-expression of the same essential nature.

Mashiach's warfare and conquests are explicitly identified AS prayer: 'וְכָל מִלְחַמְתּוֹ שֶׁיַּעֲשֶׂה וְכָל הַכְּבִישׁוֹת שֶׁיִּכְבֹּשׁ הַכֹּל מִשָּׁם' — all from the nose/prayer. The conquests ARE the manifestation of prayer in the world. Their essential nature is prayer/Mashiach.

Increasing in prayer IS prayer. 'כָּל מַה שֶּׁמַּרְבִּין בִּתְפִלָּה' — this concept's essential nature is the quantitative expansion of prayer, the accumulation of the very substance (prayer) that defines Package 1.

Smell/fragrance IS the faculty of the nose (חֹטֶם) which IS prayer. 'תְּהִלָּתִי אֶחֱטָם לָךְ' and 'וַהֲרִיחוֹ בְּיִרְאַת ה'' both identify ריח as the spiritual capacity of prayer. Though the text says 'עִקַּר הָרֵיחַ תָּלוּי בַּטָּהֳרָה' (smell depends on purity), ריח's nature IS the prayer-faculty, not purity itself. It DEPENDS ON purity but IS prayer/nose.

Binding oneself to the Tzaddikim of the generation IS the structure of prayer in this Torah: 'צָרִיךְ כָּל אֶחָד לְכַוֵּן בִּתְפִלָּתוֹ, שֶׁיְּקַשֵּׁר עַצְמוֹ לַצַּדִּיקִים שֶׁבַּדּוֹר.' The essential nature of this concept is the prayer-Tzaddik connection — bringing the Mishkan to Moshe. Package 1 already contains צדיק, צדיק הדור, משה.

Tzedakah's essential nature in this Torah IS the act of mishpat: 'אֶלֹהִים שׁוֹפֵט, זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים — שֶׁמּוֹרִישׁ לְזֶה, וּמַעֲשִׁיר לְזֶה. נִמְצָא, שֶׁאוֹחֵז עַל יְדֵי זֶה בְּמִדַּת מִשְׁפָּט.' Giving tzedakah IS the act of divine judgment (lowering oneself, raising the poor). It is the human enactment of the mishpat principle. Though it also CAUSES/ENABLES prayer, its core identity is the balancing act that IS mishpat.

The passing of the clouds from the eyes IS the rectification of mishpat: 'שֶׁיְּתֻקַּן בְּחִינַת מִשְׁפָּט... אֲזַי יִתְעַבֵּר עֲנָנִין דִּמְכַסִּין עַל עֵינָא, כִּי עַיִן בְּעַיִן יִרְאוּ.' This is the restored state of the eyes (עינים, Package 3) — the future-tense, healed version of what Package 6 describes as corrupted. Its essential nature is clear spiritual vision = rectified mishpat.

assignments.node_id: לידע איך ללחם עם החרב, שלא יטה אותה לימין או לשמאל, ושיהא קולע אל השערה ולא יחטא
assignments.reason: The skill of spiritual precision — aiming the prayer-sword without deviation — IS the quality of mishpat: 'וְזֶה אִי אֶפְשָׁר אֶלָּא עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינוֹת מִשְׁפָּט, כִּי מִשְׁפָּט הוּא עַמּוּדָא דְּאֶמְצָעִיתָא.' This concept IS the middle-column balance, IS the precision of calibrated judgment. Package 3 already has עמודא דאמצעיתא.

The completion of the Shechina's stature IS the Shechina's preparation for union: 'וּבוֹנִין קוֹמָתָהּ שֶׁל הַשְּׁכִינָה מְעַט מְעַט, עַד שֶׁיִּשְׁתַּלֵּם שִׁעוּר קוֹמָתָהּ.' The essential nature of this concept is the progressive building-up of the Shechina toward her full stature for zivug — the very definition of Package 5.

The act of completing and establishing the Shechina in wholeness IS the culmination of the Shechina-preparation process: 'וְיַשְׁלִים אוֹתָהּ, וְיָקִים אוֹתָהּ בִּשְׁלֵמוּת.' This is the final stage of what Package 5 describes — the Shechina's stature fully built, ready for and entering union.

The Shechina being built up more IS the progressive preparation: 'וְכָל מַה שֶּׁמַּרְבִּין בִּתְפִלָּה, נִבְנֶה הַשְּׁכִינָה בְּיוֹתֵר, וּמְכִינָה אֶת עַצְמָהּ לְזִוּוּג.' Though prayer CAUSES this building, the concept itself IS the Shechina's growth toward union — the exact domain of Package 5.

Evil/foreign thoughts ARE the spiritual blindness that comes from corrupted mishpat: 'עִקָּר שֶׁל הַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת זָרוֹת הֵם עַל יְדֵי קִלְקוּל הַמִּשְׁפָּט.' Package 6 already contains מחשבות זרות שבתפלה; this node (מחשבות רעות) is the same essential nature under a slightly different label — foreign/evil thoughts that cloud the spiritual eyes.
